- [ASSISTANT_CREATED] Suggested morning routine (30 minutes): catch up on overnight news (10-15 minutes), read in-depth articles (1-2 articles), take notes or reflect.
- [ASSISTANT_CREATED] Suggested evening routine (30 minutes): review the day's news (10-15 minutes), listen to a podcast or audio news, explore a specific topic (10-15 minutes).
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Provided tips to make the most of the routine: be consistent, prioritize quality over quantity, take breaks, reflect and engage, and adjust as needed.
